reviewed_by: Codex focused Work hub and Studio integration review
reason: The diff adds opt-in Work persistence, MCP and harness check-ins, an authenticated project import API, and a Studio-style responsive hub. Twenty-one Python tests, four component tests, and sixteen production-bundle real-Core browser journeys cover import retries, authorization, pagination, board updates, accessibility, and phone layouts. The frontend diagnostics audit confirms every Work failure handler is classified. Ruff lint and format, the Python diagnostic audit, and mypy also pass.
exclusions: No native code changed. Unrelated Python, frontend, and browser journeys and full suites are excluded. Browser profiles are emulated; physical-device validation is separate.
